timing.gunDescription: Reads before the gun are kept but never become timing records (tag tests, warm-ups, athletes waiting on the start mat). It is set when the race is started; correct it if the gun fired at a different time.
timing.gunNotRecorded: No gun time recorded yet. Reads are gated by the scheduled start ({{time}}).
timing.gunNoSchedule: No gun time or scheduled start is set, so no reads are gated.
timing.gunSaved: Gun time saved. Reprocess ignored reads to apply it to reads already received.
timing.gunFailed: The gun time could not be saved.
timing.gunInvalid: Enter the gun time and a reason.
timing.unmatchedDescription: Reads from tags that are not assigned to any participant in this race. Assign the tag to the right participant, then reprocess unmatched reads.
timing.unmatchedFailed: Unmatched tags could not be loaded.
timing.reprocessDescription: Raw reads are never deleted. After fixing tag assignments, the gun time, or a registration, reprocess the affected reads. Existing official corrections are never overwritten, and an earlier read can only make a time earlier.
timing.reprocessIgnored: Ignored reads (before the gun or clock faults)
timing.reprocessConfirm: Reprocess the selected reads for this race?
timing.reprocessFailed: The reads could not be reprocessed.
timing.reprocessNone: Choose at least one kind of read.
timing.clockOffsetWarning: Gateway clock is {{offset}} ms off. Configure NTP on the edge device.

waves.title: Wave starts
waves.description: Each wave has its own gun. Athletes in a wave are timed from that wave’s gun, and reads before it are ignored. Athletes without a wave use the race gun.
waves.empty: No waves. Everyone starts on the race gun.
waves.name: Wave name
waves.addFailed: The wave could not be added.
waves.startFailed: The gun time could not be recorded.
waves.corrected: Gun time corrected. Times before the new gun were moved or removed.
waves.assignNone: No athletes found in that bib range.
waves.deleteFailed: The wave could not be deleted. Move its athletes first.

keys.rotateConfirm: Issue a new key for {{name}}? The current key stops working immediately, so update the gateway right away.
keys.rotated: New key issued for {{name}}. Copy it now and update the gateway; the old key no longer works.
keys.rotateFailed: The reader key could not be rotated.
